summary_1line: After Bhishma’s fall, Karna leads the Kauravas as ominous portents appear; Drona devastates Pandava forces until they surround him to halt his advance.

image_candidates.scene_text: Karna stands at the head of the Kaurava army beneath his blazing standard while he and Arjuna glare at each other across the battlefield.
Dark dust covers the sun as meteors fall and vultures circle over armies preparing for slaughter.
Drona on a magnificent chariot cuts through the Pandava ranks like a ring of fire while warriors swarm around him.
